scriptData.code:
-- TinyStudio Physics Demo Script 
print("Game started!") 

local PointsUI = getEntityById("UIText 3") 
local points = 0 
local UIPoints = 0  -- Delayed UI score

-- Track original parts, positions, and scoring state
local oParts = getEntitiesByTag("destruct") 
local oPos = {} 
local scoredParts = {} -- Tracks if a part at index 'i' has been scored

print("Found destructable parts:", #oParts) 

for i, p in ipairs(oParts) do 
    -- Create a NEW Vector3 or it will reference the current position instead of the value!
    oPos[i] = Vector3.new(p.Transform.position.x, p.Transform.position.y, p.Transform.position.z) 
    scoredParts[i] = false
end 

function isDestroyed(i)
    local d = 0
    d = d + math.abs(oParts[i].Transform.position.x - oPos[i].x)
    d = d + math.abs(oParts[i].Transform.position.y - oPos[i].y)
    d = d + math.abs(oParts[i].Transform.position.z - oPos[i].z)

    return d > 3
end

while true do 
    -- Update score UI
    if UIPoints < points then
        UIPoints = UIPoints + 5
        UI.setText("UIText 3", tostring(UIPoints) .. " Points")
    end

    -- Check if parts moved
    for i = 1, #oParts do 
        local p = oParts[i]
        
        -- Check if it exists, hasn't been scored yet, and has moved
        if p and not scoredParts[i] then 
            if isDestroyed(i) then 
                points = points + 100 
                scoredParts[i] = true -- Mark as scored so we ignore it next time
                print("Part destroyed!") 
            end 
        end 
    end 
    
    wait(0.03) 
end
